gameDissections.gameId: ALL (G01-G09 vs 80% Baseline Commit Diff Audit 6d4aadd..917e6b1)
gameDissections.evidenceSummary: Line-by-line regression audit of all 11 commits from 6d4aadd (80% winrate baseline) to 917e6b1 proves that the winrate collapse from 80% to 11.1% (1/9) was caused by 6 interacting negative-ROI patches introduced between fd868f3 and 514a041, compounded by running pre-d590acd spawn-coordinator.mjs in Boss-less mode: (1) e20db6b+32c5689+514a041 (V7/V8): oppFloorCap 128->38, collapseFloorCap 85->16, totB=B+myOut, keep<=10~26*L caused 181 frontline hollow-out events (d_home=0~18) and threw 100% (3/3) of midgame #1 leads (G01, G04, G06); (2) fd868f3+pre-d590acd (V1/V2): VirtualSquadAnchor island traps + allyMinSep<=112 / clusterMax<=350 caused 7/10 games to suffer island fallbacks (voronoi=500) or secondary-continent lockups and cut t=1500 land by -28%; (3) e20db6b+4b7408e (V4/V9/V10): period=2 + inflight<2t (< WebSocket RTT) triggered 18 bursts (125 shots) of 5~14x 10%B assist machine-gunning, draining 50~81% of healthy allies' balances; (4) d996be6+fd868f3 (V6): pct=51 (5%B) micro-donations paid a flat 64/1024 (6.25%B) engine tax (55.2% loss rate, burning 18.71M in tax across G01-G09) while coastGuardFloor=68*L deadlocked boxed-in coastal rear bots at d=70~78; (5) 404996d (V5): bQ.mt.mu is always false for human chases (74 duplicate chases) and 35%B chase cap + no fee<=bTr gate burned 4.58M in 3.125%B boat tax while s.land undefined broke tryClaimNearTeamIslands.
